title: Stabilize Tactus dependency metadata for downstream pip resolution
description: Harden published dependency constraints in Tactus so downstream projects (for example Plexus and Call-Criteria-Python) can resolve dependencies in fresh Python 3.11 environments without excessive backtracking or hidden optional-provider churn.
